cases.sentence: Мадианитяне так угнетали их, что израильтяне стали делать себе укрытия в ___ и укрепления в пещерах.
cases.explain: «горных расселинах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made themselves the dens which are in the mountains, the caves, and the strongholds.

cases.sentence: Всякий раз, когда израильтяне сеяли, мадианитяне, амаликитяне и другие ___ вторгались в страну.
cases.explain: «восточные народы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.

cases.sentence: Гедеон пошел домой, приготовил козленка и сделал из ефы муки ___.
cases.explain: «пресного хлеба» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened cakes of an ephah  of meal. He put the meat in a basket and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out to him under the oak, and presented it.

cases.sentence: Концом посоха, который был у Него в руке, Ангел Господень прикоснулся к мясу и ___.
cases.explain: «пресному хлебу» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Then Yahweh’s angel stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the meat and the unleavened cakes; and fire went up out of the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened cakes. Then Yahweh’s angel departed out of his sight.

cases.sentence: Сооруди, как должно, жертвенник Господу, твоему Богу, на вершине этой скалы, и на дровах из столба Ашеры, который ты срубишь, принеси во всесожжение ___.
cases.explain: «второго быка» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Then build an altar to Yahweh your God on the top of this stronghold, in an orderly way, and take the second bull, and offer a burnt offering with the wood of the Asherah which you shall cut down.”

cases.sentence: Утром, когда жители города встали, жертвенник Баала был разрушен, вместе с ним срублен и столб Ашеры, а ___ принесен в жертву на новом жертвеннике!
cases.explain: «второй бык» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: When the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was broken down, and the Asherah was cut down that was by it, and the second bull was offered on the altar that was built.

cases.sentence: Утром, когда жители города встали, жертвенник Баала был разрушен, вместе с ним срублен и столб Ашеры, а второй бык принесен в жертву на ___!
cases.explain: «новом жертвеннике» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: When the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was broken down, and the Asherah was cut down that was by it, and the second bull was offered on the altar that was built.

cases.explain: «враждебной толпе» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Joash said to all who stood against him, “Will you contend for Baal? Or will you save him? He who will contend for him, let him be put to death by morning! If he is a god, let him contend for himself, because someone has broken down his altar!”

cases.sentence: Все мадианитяне, амаликитяне и другие ___ объединили силы, переправились через Иордан и встали лагерем в долине Изреель.
cases.explain: «восточные народы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed over, and encamped in the valley of Jezreel.

cases.explain: «следующий день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: It was so; for he rose up early on the next day, and pressed the fleece together, and wrung the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.
